name: Eaagads Limited
source: kenyanstocks.com financial statements API (farmed), EGAD comprehensive income, years 2024 and 2025, KES. Gross Profit is Revenue less Cost of Production plus the gain on fair value of biological assets, the same construction the stored FY2023 figure uses. Profit for the Year is Profit Before Tax less Tax (Charge)/Credit; Operating Expenses is the sum of administration and other expenses and selling and distribution expenses. Checks: 277,266,000 - 193,619,000 + 2,656,000 = 86,303,000; 17,434,000 - 5,589,000 = 11,845,000; 190,615,000 - 123,575,000 + 762,000 = 67,802,000; 7,069,000 + 2,093,000 = 9,162,000. EPS, net operating costs, cost of sales, other comprehensive income and the ratio rows are left empty for these years because the source prints no value for them.
source_note: Kshs'000 x 1,000 to absolute KES. Condensed statement: net operating costs is a single aggregated line.
